provenance.statement: This staged draft dataset was authored entirely by an AI assistant (Claude) as synthetic seed data for the Phase-1 email classifier. It is not human-curated, not golden, not BASWE-scale, and not model-evaluated. It has not been reviewed by any human and must not be used as a golden dataset, benchmark, or production evaluation source until a named human reviewer completes review and explicitly promotes it.

expansion_criterion: This staged draft dataset must not be promoted or expanded toward the BASWE 50-100-case target until a named human reviewer has reviewed and approved all 16 draft cases and records the added human-curated cases.

cases.input: I was charged twice for my monthly subscription this billing cycle, please refund the extra charge.
cases.ideal_summary: Customer was double-charged for their subscription and wants a refund.
cases.notes: Baseline unambiguous billing case with a clear refund request.
